title.en: Practical 6: Identification of plant and animal tissues

text.en: Under the microscope, every tissue shows its own pattern.

The aim is to identify the structural features of plant and animal tissues from permanent prepared slides.
Observe simple tissues (parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma), complex tissues (xylem and phloem), epithelial tissue (columnar and ciliated), connective tissue (bone), muscle tissue (skeletal, smooth and cardiac) and nerve tissue.
For each slide draw a labelled sketch and write the location and function of the tissue.
